description: An individual work item to be executed as part of a flow.

Ingest.description: Fetches data from a source and appends it to a dataset.

name.description: An alias for the task used to refer to it in flows and access the results

target.description: Reference to the dataset to ingest into. Defaults to the flow-level target when omitted.

serviceAccount.description: Service account whose permissions the task executes with. Must be an account of service account type. Defaults to the service account of the run when omitted.

source.description: Reference to the source resource that defines how to fetch data.

targetRecordsPerSlice.description: Target number of records to ingest per data slice.

Transform.description: Executes transformation of data defined in a derivative dataset.

name.description: An alias for the task used to refer to it in flows and access the results

target.description: Reference to the derivative dataset that defines how to transform data.

serviceAccount.description: Service account whose permissions the task executes with. Must be an account of service account type. Defaults to the service account of the run when omitted.

SyncFrom.description: Pulls new blocks from a remote dataset into a local dataset.

name.description: An alias for the task used to refer to it in flows and access the results

target.description: Reference to the local dataset to pull into. Defaults to the flow-level target when omitted.

serviceAccount.description: Service account whose permissions the task executes with. Must be an account of service account type. Defaults to the service account of the run when omitted.

force.description: Overwrite the local dataset even if its history has diverged from the source.

SyncTo.description: Pushes new blocks of a local dataset to a remote dataset.

name.description: An alias for the task used to refer to it in flows and access the results

target.description: Reference to the local dataset to push. Defaults to the flow-level target when omitted.

serviceAccount.description: Service account whose permissions the task executes with. Must be an account of service account type. Defaults to the service account of the run when omitted.

force.description: Overwrite the remote dataset even if its history has diverged from the local one.

createIfNotExists.description: Create the remote dataset if it does not exist.

Compaction.description: Compacts data files in matching datasets to improve query performance.

name.description: An alias for the task used to refer to it in flows and access the results

target.description: Reference to the dataset to compact. Defaults to the flow-level target when omitted.

serviceAccount.description: Service account whose permissions the task executes with. Must be an account of service account type. Defaults to the service account of the run when omitted.

maxSliceSize.description: Target maximum size of each compacted data slice e.g. `100MiB`.

maxSliceRecords.description: Target maximum number of records per compacted data slice.

Reset.description: Moves a block reference of a dataset to an earlier block, discarding the history that follows it.

name.description: An alias for the task used to refer to it in flows and access the results

target.description: Reference to the dataset to reset. Defaults to the flow-level target when omitted.

serviceAccount.description: Service account whose permissions the task executes with. Must be an account of service account type. Defaults to the service account of the run when omitted.

ref.description: Name of the block reference to reset.

newBlockHash.description: Hash of the block the reference will point to. Defaults to the `Seed` block when omitted.

oldBlockHash.description: Expected hash of the block the reference currently points to. When specified, the task fails if the reference has moved, protecting against concurrent updates.

GarbageCollection.description: Removes unreferenced data files from matching datasets.

name.description: An alias for the task used to refer to it in flows and access the results

target.description: Reference to the dataset to collect garbage from. Defaults to the flow-level target when omitted.

serviceAccount.description: Service account whose permissions the task executes with. Must be an account of service account type. Defaults to the service account of the run when omitted.

name.description: An alias for the task used to refer to it in flows and access the results

target.description: Reference to the dataset to verify. Defaults to the flow-level target when omitted.

serviceAccount.description: Service account whose permissions the task executes with. Must be an account of service account type. Defaults to the service account of the run when omitted.

replayTransform.description: If true, re-executes transformations on derivative datasets to verify reproducibility.

WebhookCall.description: Dispatches a certain payload to a specific `WebhookEndpoint`.

name.description: An alias for the task used to refer to it in flows and access the results

serviceAccount.description: Service account whose permissions the task executes with. Must be an account of service account type. Defaults to the service account of the run when omitted.

payload.description: The payload to send. May include templating.

retryPolicy.description: Defines how a webhook should react to failures.
